name: 全折叠静音家用跑步机款

category.leaf: 全折叠静音家用跑步机

description: 全折叠收纳、静音减震、宽跑带稳跑的家用跑步机套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #1B1C20 studio backdrop for hero and closing shots, clean light grey #F4F4F6 and pure white #FFFFFF for infographic and detail shots, one red accent #E5433A used sparingly
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key from the upper left with a subtle rim light on the frame, controlled speculars on metal, soft contact shadows, 5500K window light in lifestyle shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor, textured dark rubber running belt, brushed metal frame
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold headlines 28-48pt, white headlines on dark backgrounds and charcoal #2D2D2D on light backgrounds, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line callout icons and solid rounded rectangular info labels in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for full-product shots; all frame tubes, upright columns and belt edges must stay perfectly straight
noDrift: no brand logos on the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark premium fitness equipment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1C20 for hero and closing shots, clean light grey #F4F4F6 and pure white #FFFFFF for infographic shots, charcoal text #2D2D2D on light backgrounds, pure white text #FFFFFF on dark backgrounds, and one sparing red accent #E5433A; cool neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif bold headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent solid rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line callout icons; clean high-end fitness product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with balanced composition margins; all frame tubes, columns and belt edges perfectly straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 低角度暗夜氛围开场，赢搜索点击并立住高端感
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible, not clipped
shots.lighting: cool directional studio key from the upper left with a subtle rim light on the frame, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Full treadmill photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible and filling 50-60% of the frame, centered with balanced margins. Cool directional studio key light from the upper left with a subtle rim light tracing the frame, a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Deep charcoal seamless studio backdrop #1B1C20. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no people, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand marks on the product, no extra text, no warped lines, no bent frame tubes, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清全折叠收纳的核心卖点，用侧身轮廓证明折叠厚度
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, product standing folded upright on the right third
shots.lighting: cool studio key from the upper left, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C20 with one thin red accent line #E5433A along the lower edge
shots.textZone: upper left one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one subline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} shown fully folded upright. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile to show the slim folded silhouette, the product standing on the right two-thirds of the frame filling 50-60%. Cool studio key light from the upper left, soft contact shadow. Deep charcoal background #1B1C20 with one thin red accent line #E5433A along the lower edge. The upper left carries the typography: one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one subline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF, sized so the type and the folded silhouette never overlap. Negative: no dense body text, no more than two claims, no invented spec numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no warped lines, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大普通跑步机吵闹晃动、扰邻的痛点，引出静音减震方案
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing at eye level, identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light with motion blur, right panel soft even light
shots.props: abstract sound-wave marks on the left panel only
shots.textZone: one short label per panel: 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical eye-level camera and framing. Left panel: an ordinary treadmill deck shown with motion blur and vibration, under harsh flat light, with abstract sound-wave marks conveying noise. Right panel: {product} standing stable and quiet in soft even light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Light grey background #F4F4F6 on both panels. One short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right, in #2D2D2D. Each panel subject fills 50-60% of its half with balanced margins. Negative: no real faces, no fabricated statistics or decibel numbers, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no warped lines.

shots.intent: 代入居家慢跑的真实场景，让买家自我投射
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow on the floor
shots.background: bright home living room with a large window, light oak floor #C9B08E and walls #EDEBE6
shots.props: a folded towel on the console rail and a water bottle on the floor, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the window light and the open living-room floor
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} placed in a bright home living room beside a large window. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level 3/4 in-context view with a candid feel; a runner is shown only from behind using the treadmill, with no face visible. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow on the floor. Light oak floor #C9B08E and walls #EDEBE6. Props: a folded towel on the console rail and a water bottle on the floor, neither covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with the window light and the open floor giving natural breathing room. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no messy clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines.

shots.intent: 微距呈现跑带纹理与摩檫感，证明跑感扎实
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low raking angle along the belt surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the belt grain, controlled highlight
shots.textZone: one small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the running belt surface texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a low raking angle along the belt, shallow depth of field with the foreground texture sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the belt grain and layered structure. Neutral matte light grey background #F4F4F6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, whitespace minimal as the texture itself is the subject. One small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower right, no other text. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented spec numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines, no duplicated belt textures in the background.

shots.intent: 特写控制面板与显示品质，暗示智能操控
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the console, close-up detail shot
shots.lighting: soft diffused studio light from the upper left with controlled highlights on the screen glass
shots.textZone: one thin-line callout label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D beside the console
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product} focusing on the console and display. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the console. Soft diffused studio light from the upper left with controlled highlights on the screen glass. Clean white background #FFFFFF. The screen shows only a neutral abstract interface with no readable brand UI, no app logos and no real menus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, whitespace minimal as the console itself is the subject. One thin-line callout label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D beside the console. Negative: no real brand interface, no readable app screens, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines, no glare washing out the screen.

shots.intent: 微距折叠铰链与金属工艺，支撑全折叠卖点与品质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low side angle close to the floor, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: directional side light from the left raking across the metal to reveal machining and finish
shots.textZone: one small label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the upper right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the folding hinge mechanism where the deck meets the upright column. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low side angle close to the floor, shallow depth of field with the hinge sharp. Directional side light from the left raking across the metal to reveal machining and finish. Neutral matte light grey background #F4F4F6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, whitespace minimal as the hinge itself is the subject. One small label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the upper right. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented mechanism claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines, no bent metal edges.

shots.intent: 对比加厚立柱与普通立柱，消除晃动顾虑
shots.camera: two matched panels with identical straight-on camera, framing and lighting
shots.lighting: even flat lighting, identical on both panels
shots.textZone: one label per panel: 「{callout_1}」 on the right panel in #E5433A and 「{callout_2}」 on the left panel in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera, framing and lighting. Left panel: a close-up of a thin generic frame column looking slimmer and less stable, labeled 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. Right panel: a close-up of the thickened sturdy column of {product}, labeled 「{callout_1}」 in #E5433A. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean white background #FFFFFF on both panels, even flat lighting. Each panel subject fills 60-70% of its half with balanced margins. Negative: no invented measurements or thickness numbers, no competitor logos, no extra text, no watermark, no warped lines, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 结构化参数表回答尺寸承重与折叠尺寸疑虑，值由文案槽位回填
shots.camera: straight-on flat infographic layout, front view
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: two-column spec table with short field labels and short value pairs in solid rounded rows
shots.textZone: short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at the top center; spec rows carrying short label-value pairs 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat layout on a deep charcoal background #1B1C20: a two-column spec table occupying 65-75% of the frame, built from solid rounded rows each carrying one short label-value pair 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 in #FFFFFF, plus a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at the top center. Even soft studio light, no dramatic shadow. Clean structured layout. Negative: no QR codes, no brand names, no invented spec values beyond the label slots, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines.

shots.intent: 用可见的铰链做工与减震结构细节加信任标签降低购买风险
shots.camera: slight 3/4 product angle on the left, folding hinge and deck edge rendered crisply, trust labels on the right
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: three short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D on the right beside the product
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 angle filling 50-60% of the left side, its folding hinge, reinforced deck edge and dampened base structure rendered in crisp detail as the visible trust focus. Light grey background #F4F4F6, even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow. On the right, three short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D sit beside the product, each pointing at one visible build detail. Clean structured layout. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data; no fabricated badges or seals, no QR codes, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines.

shots.intent: 暗夜氛围收口，用醒目的实底行动按钮与福利文案促成下单
shots.camera: slight 3/4 low-angle view, product on the left
shots.lighting: cool studio key from the upper left with a subtle rim light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one solid rounded CTA button in #E5433A
shots.textZone: right side: short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one solid rounded CTA button in #E5433A with short button text 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product at a slight 3/4 low-angle view filling 60-70% of the left side; the right side carries the conversion block: a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF above one solid rounded CTA button in #E5433A with short button text 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF, the type kept clear of the product silhouette. Cool studio key light from the upper left with a subtle rim light, soft contact shadow. Deep charcoal background #1B1C20. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped lines, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张家用跑步机爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字与机身 logo、模特身份（仅保留跑者角色、不露脸）、原文案（全折叠变身精灵/了不起的小设计等）、参数数值（3.5HP/59CM/70MM 等）、会员二维码与水印；屏幕 UI 一律中性抽象，产品以 {product} 占位，参数与认证不在图内虚构，由文案槽位回填。
